THE DR. CARE METHODOLOGY

How We Protect Your Car's Original Value

1. Clear Coat (الورنيش الشفاف)

95% of swirl marks & scuffs live in this top transparent layer. We level only micro-microns using RUPES orbitals without thinning your paint.

2. Base Coat (طبقة اللون الأساسية)

Carries the factory metallic or pearl pigment. Completely untouched by our Meguiar's micro-compounds.

3. 100% Factory Resale Value

Zero repainting means your vehicle passes any paint-gauge inspection 100% original (فابريكا بالكامل بدون رش).

1. Polymer Encapsulation

High-lubricity polymers lift and encapsulate dust particles away from the paint surface so they never scratch during wipe-down.

2. Virgin Edgeless Microfiber

We use dedicated high-GSM ultrasonic-cut towels per vehicle panel—eliminating cross-contamination and wash swirls.

3. Hydrophobic Mirror Shield

Leaves an anti-static, UV-resistant carnauba & ceramic polymer seal that repels Cairo dust for weeks.

1. At Your Home or Office Parking

No waiting at crowded wash bays. Our mobile atelier arrives directly at your villa, compound, or underground garage.

2. Zero Water Mess

100% compound-friendly eco-dry technology with zero water runoff or sludge in your private parking spot.

3. 4 Dedicated Cairo Zones

Serving Heliopolis, Nasr City, 5th Settlement, and Madinaty every Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
